The incumbent has filled its niche. Peak = anchor 0.3327 (2025, the last full reported year) x multiple 0.4. The multiple is a JUDGEMENT. Case for a higher multiple: the label covers all comers with no B7-H4 cut-off. Confirmed ORR was 62% (21/34 at 5.8 mg/kg) against Elahere's 42% in MIRASOL. B7-H4 is a new target, so it can follow an FRalpha ADC. Case against: the PROC launch is about 2032, behind four rivals: - Genmab's Rina-S, an FRalpha ADC (NCT06619236, primary completion 2027-02). - R-DXd from Daiichi Sankyo and Merck (REJOICE-Ovarian01, NCT06161025, 2028-02, Breakthrough). - AZD5335 (NCT07218809, 2028-11). - Sofetabart (2030).
